title: The Human Flourishing Geographic Index: A County-Level Dataset for the United States, 2013–2023
reasoning: The paper explicitly measures and analyzes dimensions of religious faith and moral virtue. It includes 48 indicators, several of which are specifically dedicated to religious discourse (e.g., 'belief in god', 'afterlife', 'religious comfort', 'spiritual punishment') and moral character (e.g., 'virtue', 'altruism', 'forgiveness'). Section 4.3 is dedicated to analyzing the 'Geography of Religious Discourse' and validating these measures against established religious surveys.
